scenario.name: Cyclist alongside on the inside of a turn
scenario.description: A cyclist or scooter rider rides up on the inside as the vehicle turns, or swerves between lanes round an obstacle

events.description: Steers into a cyclist in or beside the lane

triggers.condition: Cyclists riding between lanes or swerving round obstacles

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.pass: No steering command whose swept path comes within the safe lateral distance of the cyclist is executed; the vehicle waits or stops in lane

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 1.6 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

parameters.range: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed
parameters.label: Cyclist speed and lateral motion: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: waits for the cyclist
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-04.2 Steers into a cyclist in or beside the lane
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
